sounds.label: Interface sounds
sounds.description: A short chime for a claimed reward, a new level and a finished session. Never while you play.

email_notifications.title: Email notifications
email_notifications.description: Choose which emails you want to receive from Riff Quest. We only send the ones you turn on.

streakReminders.title: Streak reminders
streakReminders.description: Get a nudge when you haven't practiced for a day or two, so you don't break your streak.

seasonUpdates.title: Season updates
seasonUpdates.description: Emails about new seasons starting, seasons ending soon and your final results.

productUpdates.title: What's new at Riff Quest
productUpdates.description: Once in a while, a short roundup of what's new in the app.

email_notifications.always_sent: Account and security emails (like email changes) are always sent and can't be turned off.

email_consent.title: Can we send you emails?
email_consent.intro: Hey! We'd like to ask whether we can email you. We should have asked earlier, and we didn't.
email_consent.intro_new: Hey! One quick question before you dive in: can we email you now and then?
email_consent.privacy: We respect your privacy, so we won't send you anything without your permission.
email_consent.change_later: You can change this anytime in {{settings}}.

tablature.title: Tablature
tablature.description: Change how exercises are drawn. Everything is saved on this device and applies to your next practice session.
tablature.hint_tab: Hit colour and hit animations only show while you are actually playing.
tablature.hint_notation: The same viewer used mid-session — toggle the board below to see it on paper or on black.

profile_basics.display_name_hint: This name is visible on leaderboards and your public profile.

streak.title: Streak
streak.subtitle: How your daily streak is counted.
streak.label: Rest day
streak.description: One missed day a week (Monday to Sunday) won't break your streak, though it won't add a day either. Two missed days in a row always end it.

mcp.title: AI assistants (MCP)
mcp.subtitle: Connect Claude, Cursor or another AI app to your riff.quest account. It can read your practice, plan sessions and write exercises with tabs.
mcp.label_placeholder: Name, e.g. Claude on my laptop
mcp.allow_writes_description: Let the assistant save plans, goals, songs and exercises (up to 20 changes a day). Without it, it can only read.
mcp.token_once: Copy this token now — it won't be shown again.
mcp.other_clients: Other apps: add a remote MCP server with this address and the header Authorization: Bearer <token>.
mcp.connector_hint: In claude.ai or Claude Desktop: Settings → Connectors → Add custom connector, paste this address and sign in. No token needed.

oauth.title: {{app}} wants to connect to your riff.quest account
oauth.subtitle: It will be able to see your practice history, goals, skills and songs, and use the exercise library.
oauth.returns_to: After you decide, you'll go back to
oauth.loopback_warning: This app runs on your own computer. Only allow it if you started it yourself just now.
oauth.can_read: Read your practice data — always included.
oauth.invalid_description: Go back to the app and try connecting again. If it keeps happening, the app may not support riff.quest yet.
